entries.name: Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Our selected perk overhaul; follow its quarantine list.
entries.detail: Use the agreed collection. Not every perk has been tested with four players.

entries.name: Mysticism
entries.summary: Our selected spell overhaul: main package only.
entries.detail: Some spells and summon stats come from Better Vanilla Perks. Mark, Recall and corpse reanimation are quarantined (don't use yet). Keep the optional addons outside this setup. Exact four-player spell behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Imperious — Races of Skyrim
entries.summary: Our selected race overhaul, with four quarantined powers.
entries.detail: Quarantined (don't use yet): Red Sand Dance, Contingency, Beast Tongue and Spirit Walk. Other racial effects and personal unlock progress are not tested yet in this party. NPCs also receive racial abilities.

entries.name: Strong Reflexes rank 1 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: The Block 30 shield-protection rank is allowed.
entries.detail: This rank reduces damage from power attacks while shield blocking. It is not the time-slow rank. Stop before rank 2; exact four-player behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Strong Reflexes rank 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Skip this perk at Block 50.
entries.detail: It slows time when blocking power attacks. Slow time can synchronize across the party; this is a shared-pacing quarantine until tested.

entries.name: Steady Hand rank 1 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Skip this perk at Archery 40.
entries.detail: Aiming with zoom slows time. It can affect everybody's fight. The entire Steady Hand branch stays quarantined (don't use yet) until tested.

entries.name: Steady Hand rank 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Keep the whole Steady Hand branch unselected.
entries.detail: The second rank's tooltip does not establish that the first rank's slowdown disappears. Do not use it to bypass the rank 1 quarantine.

entries.name: Dark Souls 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Do not use exploding reanimated corpses.
entries.detail: This perk adds an explosion to corpse-based reanimation, which is itself quarantined (don't use yet). Exact party behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Dragonborn rank 4: spectral drum — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Do not use the spectral drum power from Speech 60.
entries.detail: Its follower stamina effect is not a verified player buff. The power is quarantined (don't use yet) until tested; the rule concerns the granted power.

entries.name: Dragonborn rank 5: Dremora Merchant — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Do not summon the merchant granted at Speech 80.
entries.detail: The merchant actor and barter behavior are not tested yet with the party. The rule concerns this granted power.

entries.name: Torch-assisted automatic unlocking — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Pick locks by hand for now.
entries.detail: The automatic torch-based opening needs observation on both clients. Normal manual lockpicking remains allowed.

entries.name: Manual lockpicking
entries.summary: Use lockpicks normally, and coordinate shared containers.
entries.detail: Ordinary lock state is supported by Skyrim Together. This does not clear the quarantined torch-assisted automatic unlocking.

entries.name: More than one active summon per player
entries.summary: Keep one active summoned actor per player.
entries.detail: Extra capacity from perks does not change this rule. The limit is our initial test budget, not a Skyrim Together engine limit. Corpse reanimation and quarantined special powers remain excluded.

entries.name: Summoner — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Extra summon capacity stays unused: one active summon per player.
entries.detail: The perk's extra slots are not permission to add actors. Corpse reanimation remains quarantined (don't use yet). Exact four-player behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Puppeteer — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Extra summon capacity stays unused: one active summon per player.
entries.detail: The perk's extra slots are not permission to add actors. Corpse reanimation remains quarantined (don't use yet). Exact four-player behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Twin Souls — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Extra summon capacity stays unused: one active summon per player.
entries.detail: The perk's extra slots are not permission to add actors. Corpse reanimation remains quarantined (don't use yet). Exact four-player behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Dragonborn rank 2 — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Extra summon capacity stays unused: one active summon per player.
entries.detail: The perk's extra slots are not permission to add actors. Corpse reanimation remains quarantined (don't use yet). Exact four-player behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Resurgence — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: Quarantined (don't use yet) until the group's first healer test.
entries.detail: Its listed 30% bonus and Skyrim Together's player healing differ, so its real effect on friends is unknown until we test it.

entries.name: Staff of the Atronach — Better Vanilla Perks
entries.summary: A staff-build option; exact effects are not tested yet.
entries.detail: Potent flame, frost and storm atronachs and their thralls use Better Vanilla Perks stats. Staff and summon behavior needs checking. Keep the one-summon limit.

entries.name: Red Sand Dance — Imperious
entries.summary: Do not use this racial power in our campaign.
entries.detail: The Redguard power slows time and can change everyone's fight. This is quarantined until we test it together.

entries.name: Contingency — Imperious
entries.summary: Do not use this racial power in our campaign.
entries.detail: The High Elf power automatically casts stored spells; the stored effect and remote result are not tested yet. This is quarantined until we test it together.

entries.name: Beast Tongue — Imperious
entries.summary: Do not use this racial power in our campaign.
entries.detail: The Wood Elf power adds an animal companion; its ownership and behavior are not tested yet. This is quarantined until we test it together.

entries.name: Spirit Walk — Imperious
entries.summary: Do not use this racial power in our campaign.
entries.detail: The Dark Elf power summons ancestors through a special racial system; it is not cleared by the ordinary one-summon allowance. This is quarantined until we test it together.

entries.name: Discipline — Imperious
entries.summary: Choose an Imperial without relying on a party aura.
entries.detail: Discipline affects armor and damage; it is not a healing aura. Its effect on human players is not tested yet. Racial abilities also apply to NPCs.

entries.name: Harrier — Imperious
entries.summary: The Wood Elf marking effect needs observation on both clients.
entries.detail: This passive is not a cleared party-wide debuff. Its exact behavior and racial progression are not tested yet.

entries.name: Whispers — Imperious
entries.summary: The Dark Elf marking and reward system needs observation.
entries.detail: Its exact behavior and personal racial progression are not tested yet. Spirit Walk remains quarantined (don't use yet).

entries.name: Prowl — Imperious
entries.summary: This is a leap, not a teleport.
entries.detail: Movement behavior in this exact party is not tested yet. Stay with the group and report differences between players' screens.

entries.name: Shared Ancestry — Imperious
entries.summary: Borrowing a racial power does not bypass its quarantine.
entries.detail: Apply the same quarantine rules to any borrowed ability. Exact behavior with the party is not tested yet.

entries.name: Mark — Mysticism
entries.summary: Do not use this travel spell in our campaign.
entries.detail: Mark and Recall alter travel state and need a separate multiplayer test. Their current co-op behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Recall — Mysticism
entries.summary: Do not use this travel spell in our campaign.
entries.detail: Mark and Recall alter travel state and need a separate multiplayer test. Their current co-op behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Corpse reanimation
entries.summary: Do not raise dead bodies in this campaign.
entries.detail: This applies to corpse-raising spells, staves and scrolls, including Raise Zombie, Reanimate Corpse, Revenant, Dread Zombie and Dead Thrall. Ordinary conjured undead are a separate, limited option.

entries.name: Conjure Skeleton — Mysticism
entries.summary: An ordinary summon candidate; keep one active summon per player.
entries.detail: Conjuring an actor is different from raising a corpse. Ownership, hostility, doors, death and reconnect behavior in this exact party are not tested yet.

entries.name: Ordinary creature summons
entries.summary: Start with one active summon per player.
entries.detail: Conjure Familiar uses Better Vanilla Perks' magic effect. Potent flame, frost and storm atronachs and their thralls use its stats. Quarantined racial summons, copied actors, corpse raising and summon armies remain excluded. Exact four-player behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Healing Hands — Mysticism
entries.summary: An approved starting option for healing another player.
entries.detail: Skyrim Together recognizes ordinary restore-health effects. Exact targeting, healing amount, skill experience and perk bonuses with this pack are not tested yet.

entries.name: Heal Other — Mysticism
entries.summary: An approved starting option for healing another player.
entries.detail: Skyrim Together recognizes ordinary restore-health effects. Exact targeting, healing amount, skill experience and perk bonuses with this pack are not tested yet.

entries.name: Grand Healing — Mysticism
entries.summary: An approved starting option for healing another player.
entries.detail: Skyrim Together recognizes ordinary restore-health effects. Exact targeting, healing amount, skill experience and perk bonuses with this pack are not tested yet.

entries.name: Ordinary self-healing spells
entries.summary: Personal healing is part of the shared setup.
entries.detail: Use the version in the collection. This does not mean every custom healing aura can heal friends, or that a healing spell can resurrect a player.

entries.name: Courage
entries.summary: Skyrim Together has explicit player-target support for this buff.
entries.detail: The exact result with our mods is not tested yet. Do not extend this support to every custom aura or bard buff.

entries.detail: The exact result with our mods is not tested yet. Do not extend this support to every custom aura or bard buff.

entries.detail: The exact result with our mods is not tested yet. Do not extend this support to every custom aura or bard buff.

entries.name: Vampiric Touch — Mysticism
entries.summary: A direct offensive spell option for a blood mage.
entries.detail: These spells are present in the selected package. Exact damage and interactions in our four-player party are not tested yet. They do not permit corpse raising.

entries.name: Vampiric Bolt — Mysticism

entries.detail: These spells are present in the selected package. Exact damage and interactions in our four-player party are not tested yet. They do not permit corpse raising.

entries.name: Blood Lance — Mysticism
entries.summary: A direct offensive spell option for a blood mage.
entries.detail: These spells are present in the selected package. Exact damage and interactions in our four-player party are not tested yet. They do not permit corpse raising.

entries.name: Direct fire, frost and shock spells
entries.summary: Use direct attacks as the starting point for a mage.
entries.detail: Flames and Frostbite use Better Vanilla Perks in either hand. Each keeps one effect; Mysticism's extra effects are absent. Sparks uses Better Vanilla Perks casting settings. Its effect amounts and durations match Mysticism. Avoid friendly NPCs. Exact co-op behavior is not tested yet.

entries.name: Calm, Fear and Frenzy on enemies
entries.summary: Use enemy-control spells against valid NPC targets.
entries.detail: AI-driven spells do not control other human players. Exact limits and behavior with our spell changes are not tested yet.

entries.name: Conjurer's Cure and other undead-healing effects
entries.summary: Do not assume an undead heal works on a player.
entries.detail: Some undead-healing effects lack the ordinary health-restoration marker. Player targeting is not tested yet. Build party healing around Healing Hands, Heal Other or Grand Healing.

entries.name: Ghostwalk — Mysticism
entries.summary: Invisibility that refreshes after it breaks.
entries.detail: Mysticism 2.5 describes refreshing invisibility after it breaks. Its exact co-op behavior is not tested yet.
